idea-plugin.name: Gin-Decompiler
idea-plugin.description:
Gin Decompiler

BACKGROUND:

Some JARs from Third-party without xxx-source.jar uploaded that caused couldn't search Keys in JARs, use this plugin to decompile JARs to xxx-sources.jar could solve the issue.

Right-click a .jar file and select Gin-Decompiler to generate a -sources.jar with decompiled Java source code.

How to Use

  1. In the Project view, right-click any .jar file
  2. Select Gin-Decompiler
  3. A {name}-sources.jar will be generated next to the original JAR
